header: Launching your Amazon OpenSearch Service domains within a VPC
content:
VPC
You can launch AWS resources, such as Amazon OpenSearch Service domains, into a virtual private
cloud (VPC). A VPC is a virtual network that's dedicated to your AWS account. It's logically isolated
from other virtual networks in the AWS Cloud. Placing an OpenSearch Service domain within a
VPC enables secure communication between OpenSearch Service and other services within the
VPC without the need for an internet gateway, NAT device, or VPN connection. All traﬃc remains
securely within the AWS Cloud.

Note
If you place your OpenSearch Service domain within a VPC, your computer must be able
to connect to the VPC. This connection often takes the form of a VPN, transit gateway,
managed network, or proxy server. You can't directly access your domains from outside the
VPC.
